verdict.rationale: Windmill documents several first-party programmatic surfaces: the `wmill` CLI for working with instances from the terminal, scoped user tokens, CLI/Git-based deployment and Git sync. Together these cover a meaningful slice of UI operations outside the UI, but no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing at the tried public paths. Missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity statement, a published REST/OpenAPI reference, evidence that admin/permissions/app-builder operations are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Windmill CLI, `wmill` allows you to interact with Windmill instances right from your terminal.
Tokens can be scoped to restrict access to specific resources and actions, following the principle of least privilege.
Windmill supports both UI-based operations via its webIDE and low-code builders, as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
